subject.title: Park channel plugin blocker dry-run effects

question: Should this intentionally empty parked PR be closed now, or kept open until the broader Doctor dry-run substrate is approved and merged?
rationale: The code problem was removed by the revert, but the protected label and the still-unsettled Doctor dry-run product surface require human cleanup direction rather than automated closure.

options.title: Close the parked no-op PR

options.title: Keep it parked
options.body: Leave the empty draft open as a reminder while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84472 and related dry-run work settle.

options.title: Rebuild on substrate work
options.body: Have the author rebase or fold the channel-plugin-blocker preview into the broader dry-run substrate once maintainers choose that path.

recommendation.title: Close the parked no-op PR
recommendation.body: Close this PR now and ask for a fresh narrow PR after the supported Doctor dry-run entry point lands.
